by: claude: tax back-fill 2015 onward, the four taxes the ten-year report reads (Netherlands)
note: Netherlands tax years 2015 to 2023 (calendar). Box 3 (the net wealth row) from the Belastingdienst's own year pages: Fiscale informatie 2019 to 2023 and berekening box 3-inkomen 2021 to 2023 (live), and dated Wayback copies of its 2015 to 2018 pages. Capital gains, solidarity and securities-account rows from PwC copies dated inside each year (last reviewed date in the note), and the EY Worldwide Personal Tax Guide 2015-16 for 2015 (no PwC copy dated in 2015). 2017 to 2022: Box 3 is a banded deemed-return system; see the note on those rows. 2024 and 2025 were already on file.

rates.thr_note: Tax-free allowance per person (double for fiscal partners).
rates.note: Box 3 is an income tax on a deemed return, not a wealth tax in name, and it works as one. Up to and including 2016: a deemed return of 4% of net assets above the allowance, taxed at 30% = 1.2% (Belastingdienst page "Berekenen belasting over vermogen tot en met 2016": https://web.archive.org/web/20161129093530/http://www.belastingdienst.nl:80/wps/wcm/connect/bldcontentnl/belastingdienst/prive/vermogen_en_aanmerkelijk_belang/vermogen/belasting_betalen_over_uw_vermogen/grondslag_sparen_en_beleggen/berekenen_belasting_over_vermogen_tot_en_met_2016). The allowance of €21,330 for 2015 is from the Belastingdienst heffingsvrij-vermogen page (this source).

rates.thr_note: Tax-free allowance per person (double for fiscal partners).
rates.note: Box 3 is an income tax on a deemed return, not a wealth tax in name, and it works as one. Up to and including 2016: a deemed return of 4% of net assets above the allowance, taxed at 30% = 1.2%. Allowance €24,437 per person (the page's example: 2 x €24,437 for partners).

rates.thr_note: Tax-free allowance per person (double for fiscal partners).
rates.note: Box 3 is an income tax on a deemed return, not a wealth tax in name, and it works as one. NOT ONE RATE: the deemed return rises in 3 bands of the base above the allowance, so one headline rate cannot express it. Stored: headline = the top band (the rate on the part above the last band limit), min = the lowest band. Effective rates (30% x the band's deemed return): 0.861% up to €75,000, 1.38% from €75,000 to €975,000, 1.617% above €975,000 (limits on the base above the allowance). Applied to all of a portfolio above the allowance, the headline overstates the tax for a base below the top band limit. Belastingdienst table "berekening rendement op vermogen over 2017": band returns 2.871% / 4.600% / 5.39% (savings 1.63%, investments 5.39%). Allowance €25,000 (Belastingdienst, Fiscale informatie 2017: https://web.archive.org/web/20190723195554/https://www.belastingdienst.nl/wps/wcm/connect/bldcontentnl/belastingdienst/prive/aangifte_doen/fiscale_informatie/fiscale_informatie_2017/heffingsvrij-vermogen-box-3-veranderd). The effective rates are derived from the stated percentages.

rates.thr_note: Tax-free allowance per person (double for fiscal partners).
rates.note: Box 3 is an income tax on a deemed return, not a wealth tax in name, and it works as one. NOT ONE RATE: the deemed return rises in 3 bands of the base above the allowance, so one headline rate cannot express it. Stored: headline = the top band (the rate on the part above the last band limit), min = the lowest band. Effective rates (31% x the band's deemed return): 0.588% up to €50,000, 1.395% from €50,000 to €950,000, 1.764% above €950,000 (limits on the base above the allowance). Applied to all of a portfolio above the allowance, the headline overstates the tax for a base below the top band limit. TWO METHODS for 2021, the more favourable one applies (Belastingdienst, berekening box 3-inkomen 2021, the newest page): (a) the old bands (Fiscale informatie 2021: savings 0.03% and investments 5.69%, mixed 67/33 and 21/79: https://www.belastingdienst.nl/wps/wcm/connect/fisin/fisin2021/belastingberekening); (b) actual holdings: investments 5.69%, bank balances 0.01%, debts 2.46%, so 1.764% on investments. For a portfolio of investments only, (a) is the lower. Allowance €50,000 per person; debts count above €3,200. The effective rates are derived from the stated percentages.
